reviews.text: It’s taken me a few days to write this as my experience was painful. My precious cat was hit by a ebike (we think). I rushed to the vet with my young boys. Frasier (our cat) wasn’t breathing and was limp and (though I didn’t want to believe it) dead when we entered. They took him back and préformed CPR and came to the same conclusion a few minutes later - he died. Of course me and my boys were devastated and crying, and the vet staff was very kind. We just wanted to take the cat and leave but it took ten min to wait on paperwork. Then I closed out to a SEVEN HUNDRED DOLLAR BILL! For a DOA cat. Approx $450 for cpr. $150 for the visit and $100ish for some odds and ends. Talk about salt on a wound. They said “sorry” and offed a credit card (no thanks - so I’d end up paying more!). I don’t even know what to do at this point. A partial refund is in order at the very least. But the thought of going back to the vet is just too painful.
Your feedback is highly appreciated, Tri. Thank you so much for the review!
Cannot possibly say enough about how wonderful this vet is. We were treated so well by Kirsty and Dr. Snyder! Our cat is so grateful and so are we! Affordable, genuine care!!!!
Hi, S. We appreciate the rating. So glad we could provide you with a positive experience at Washington Ave Animal Hospital!
Dr Grace Snyder was fantastic with our doggie and her staff was extremely knowledgeable and friendly! We highly recommend this animal hospital.
Great service! Always treats my dogs well!

Dr.Cantor and Kerri were extremely straightforward and reassuring when it came to our cat’s care. They took the time to explain his health and the possible avenues of treatment we had. They are so personable and great at what they do, I would definitely recommend them for any pet services.
The staff was super helpful and very friendly. They helped us in a time of need. I appreciate their availability and flexibility
Hi, Anna. Great to hear that you had a good experience at Washington Ave Animal Hospital. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!
Dr. Snyder is caring and great at her job. Identified the issue with our cat Stevie Pickles, prescribe the correct medicine and now he’s on the mend. ❤️‍🩹 highly recommended …
I really loved the environment, professional service and clean office. The vet staff and front desk people friendly.

We see Washington Ave vets for our dog’s regular care and occasionally urgent care needs. The prices are a bit higher than where we used to go in our neighborhood, but it is well worth it for the quality facilities, modern care, and ease of making appointments. My dog is very nervous at the vet, but they do a good job of working with her. Definitely worth the drive.

The Front desk was welcoming, the nursing assistant who weighed Ace in and checked his vitals was attentive and pleasant.  Dr Snyder, was very knowledgeable, pleasant and genuinely caring. I would definitely recommend and continue to use their services.
Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, Alex !
The best hospital ever for your pet
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Barbara! We are delighted that you had a great experience with Washington Ave Animal Hospital .
Very friendly and professional. Clean building. Treated my little girl with the utmost care! Low-cost too. Listened to my concerns and addressed all of my questions wonderfully
Friendly, accommodating, great communication

It was a great experience they help my dog a lot if it wasn’t for them she wouldn’t be here they was gentle respectful and kind to my dog she was in bad shape and they treated her with care and love I highly recommend this place

I watch my sister’s pitbull sometimes.  He’s friendly overly affectionate 93lb middle aged guy.  This time he got an ear infection, decided to take him to a local vet to save my sister the hassle and  get him some ear drops.  Schedule a same day appointment.  The office is .9 miles from my place, about a 30 minute walk.  Appointment was at 10:30am.  I leave early so he’ll have time to chill, the temp was below 80.  He’ll burn some energy and I’m sure they’ll appreciate that.
We arrive and there is a lot of back and forth about ownership consent.  All good.  The vet tech comes in early, takes ear swabs and temp.  He’s too hot she so she sprays his paws with alcohol and goes to get the dr.
The dr refuses to see him and refers him to the emergency hospital 2 blocks away, because he was too hot.  Uhh… ok.   So I take him to the hospital they immediately code him because this place called ahead.  All of a sudden I’m consenting to emergency stabilization and cpr.  It was actually the weirdest experience.
So basically I spent over $600 for ear drops and him to sit in front of a fan for an hour.  The waiting room is full of worried people,  and his fine the whole time ass comes charging out to headbutt me.  I mean I did deserve it for being this gullible.  Huge waste of time and money for me, and probably resources for the hospital.
But ok lesson learned, even vets pull scams fine.  He got his ear drops.
We could have left it all there, no review.  Except this office has been attempting to contact me nonstop to schedule another visit since then.  I told them to stop, repeatedly.  I’ve blocked them.  Today they called my sister.  Who lives out of state.  No part of this was a good experience and I look forward to never doing business with them again.
Your feedback is highly appreciated, Dolores. Thank you so much for the review!

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! ⭐ We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you chose to trust our team with your pet’s care. We’d love to hear more about your visit and find out who your furry family member is! 🐾 We look forward to seeing you both again! …

Fortunately, there was a cancellation and saw my Louie (dog) right away. From the moment I walked in the door, the vet nurse, and the doctor, they were all so kind and loving towards Louie. Louie didn’t want to leave. Lol
WAA staff is knowledgeable and caring about my pet. They are diverse which allows for an extra level of understanding for humans.

We’re sorry to see your one-star rating. We’re unable to identify a client or patient associated with this review, and no details were provided to help us understand your experience. We take client feedback seriously and would appreciate the opportunity to learn more. Please contact the hospital directly and ask to speak with a member of our management team so we can better understand and address your concerns.

First time dog dads here! A few friends recommended this vet to us and we couldn’t have had a better first visit. Everyone was friendly and efficient! They made sure our fur baby was comfortable and cared for. Can’t recommend this place enough! Thanks!
Hi, Kristen. Great to hear that you had a good experience at Washington Ave Animal Hospital. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Emily! We are delighted that you had a great experience with Washington Ave Animal Hospital .
Staff was pleasant and patient with my cat. The doctor reviewed finding and treatment options

I bring my dog Washington Ave Animal Hospital because they not only treat my pet well , they treat me with respect.  Some places forget that a sick pet is stressful to the owner.  The staff listens and explain the process of getting you furbaby well again   I appreciate that.   Qiqi’s mom.
After the experience I had with the previous vet!!! They are so nice and informative.
So far, so good! Have been twice and both experiences with my cat were positive. The space is clean and the staff is extremely nice.
The team is lovely and helpful, but the wait time was a bit long. For an annual check up, we were here for over an hour and a half.

Everyone I interacted with--reception, nurse, and vet--were kind and communicative throughout the entire time I was in the office. The nurse was very gentle with my cat, and her calm energy helped relax him in a stressful new environment. Dr. Robinson was similarly calming for Romeo, and even though she had to touch his injured leg to assess him, he clearly trusted her to do it. It's so clear to me that the medical staff love helping animals. The treatment options were clearly laid out for me, including costs and the possibility of a payment if necessary (it wasn't because of the options chosen, but I appreciated the fact that they made it known immediately so that cost wouldn't be prohibitive).

Staff contacted me a few days later to check on my cat and see how he was doing, which I really appreciated. Even though WAAH isn't my usual vet and I used them on Saturday because my normal vet was closed, I highly highly recommend them.

I want to start by saying everyone I have dealt with at this clinic is respectful and nice, but it seems there are more inherent issues with the business structure.

It feels a lot like Private Equity.  Short time with the doctor, very little communication and follow up.  I had issues with my dog and in order to get the results from a test I had to follow up by phone call several times, because “my” doctor was either too busy or not working, to review the exam I paid to have done for my sick dog.

While I was trying to follow up with a doctor I was told I would be called back which never happened, put on hold for over 30 minutes, and told my request was “submitted to their computer system”. I had to drive to the clinic and walk in to have my medication filled, and never had my questions answers.  The doctors diagnosis was an email and presecirption, with absolutely no explanation of the illness, treatment, or possible side effects. After poor results, I went for a second opinion and was given an overview of options and plethora of information.  I never felt rushed or like a burden, which cannot be said about Washington Ave.  I suspect the clinic is overscheduling the staff to put profits before patients.

Lastly, they have contact info listed for “clinical directors”, but I am not sure why.  I emailed both administrators with my dissatisfaction, because I would prefer to not leave a public review, but was completely ignored.

I hope they can improve

Nutrition, exercise, dental care, and a great veterinary team conducting annual wellness checks are key to preventing so many health emergencies. Washington Ave fits the bill. I have a client who takes their dog here and after helping with her transport and attending some appointments with her, I decided to take my dogs here for their annuals. Beauty loved Dr. Cantor. Fear-free practice, incredibly understanding and accommodating of budget needs, all with true passion and care for their clients. I was able to get her general wellness examination, creatinine test, and receive some anxiety medication for our upcoming trip. We found out we need to clean her ears more but otherwise she’s doing great. We almost lost her last year to rhabdomyolysis during a hiking excursion that she had too much fun on - it is thanks to amazing veterinary professionals and modern medical science that she has not only made a full recovery, but she is able to spend time with us today and onward. Although she was not treated by Washington Ave when this happened, I can confidently say I trust them to help me monitor her kidneys and support her well-being. My husky will be doing his wellness visits here also, though he is young and blessed to not have any major concerns or medical conditions.
A friend of mine suggested that I come here, and it didn’t disappoint. The staff was very friendly and professional, and Dr. Cantor calmed my fears. I highly recommend this facility!
front desk provides medical guidance only. No service was offered.
The staff was very professional and kind! My pet received the help he needed. I am very satisfied with the service! It was a bit pricey, but they waived the check-up fee for being the first visit.
Great Drs & Great staff! Thanks 4 treating my cat  🐈‍⬛️ . Love ❤️ u all.
The whole staff is extremely friendly and very caring of your pet. They make sure to always check in before and even after your visit to Make sure everything is ok.

Thank you so much for the 5-star review! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful that you chose Washington Avenue Animal Hospital for Yohun's care. It was our pleasure to care for him, and we look forward to seeing you both again in the future!
What a great experience! Huge shoutout to Julie for making our pup feel so welcome!
Excellent experience taking my cat here. They truly have people that care for your fur babies.
Calm, patient,  gentle and thorough.
Patient, thorough, compassionate vet services! My anxious dog was tended to with expert care.  My questions were answered and we were checked in on the next day.

so kind, gentle, patient. great hours. extremely thoughtful and understanding staff and doctors. 10/10. i have a senior dog and they were so sweet to her and i had a wonderful experience. responsible pricing and no pressuring for extra services.

Washington Animal Hospital showed exceptional care. They listened to every concern, answered every question, and their thoughtful follow‑up calls gave us real peace of mind about bringing our loved one there
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Vanessa! We are delighted that you had a great experience with Washington Ave Animal Hospital .

Was honestly shocked how pleasant this experience was it genuinely felt like they loved my cats gushing so much about how cute they are and handling them with so much care. they were so thoughtful making them as comfortable as possible my kitty is an anxious girl and likes to hide when scared and they covered her head with a towel for the exam and her heart rate instantly went down and she seemed much calmer. Little things like that are huge to me , thanks guys !!!!

Brought my senior dog last week , he was very sick and unfortunately there was not too much to do besides letting him go in peace and with dignity ,  I’m a physician and I have discussions about goals of care several times a week , however when it came to my senior dog I was a wreck .. the staff from the front desk to the Veterinarian were amazing, sensitive and very professional and caring.   I hope you all take care of yourselves as I realize now the emotional burden that comes from living and performing Euthanasia on a regular basis . Forever grateful though I’m still dealing with the guilt that comes from that ….  Alexander , Alejandro and Rocco ❤️🐾💔

We recently got our kitten spayed and couldn’t be happier with the experience! The doctors talked us through what the procedure would be like and kept us updated throughout the process. They took great care of our baby and she healed wonderfully! Very friendly staff who are happy to answer questions. I feel so lucky to have Washington Ave Animal Hospital as our baby’s vet!
Amazing care and team! Brought our cat here, reasonably pricing, excellent care. Easy to schedule an appointment.

Having a veterinarian who shares our sense of the problems our cat faces as he ages is important. At our last appointment the place was clean, we were seen right away, and both the attending and the physician were kind and attentive to the animal.
I took our golden for ear infections and also to be neutered, the staff and the doctors are incredible

I’ve been a loyal client for years and have spent thousands of dollars trusting this practice with my two dogs. When we first started coming here, the staff was warm, attentive, and genuinely patient with my anxious pups they truly made them feel comfortable and cared for.

Unfortunately, that experience has changed significantly. Exams feel rushed, costs have skyrocketed, and even minor procedures or services come with a hefty price tag that’s hard to justify.

The final straw was their decision to cut ties with low cost pharmacies like Chewy. They previously offered a convenient portal to send prescriptions directly, but that’s gone now they either push you to purchase medications through them at a premium, or require you to mail in a physical script. It’s an unnecessary inconvenience that feels deliberately designed to protect their bottom line.

Quality of care used to be the priority here. Sadly, it no longer feels that way. If that matters to you, I’d look elsewhere.

I  take my now-17-1/2 year old Havanese, Joey, to Dr. Ellen Manneschmidt at Washington Ave because she is just fabulous. Wise, knowledgable and compassionate.  Those qualities are even more important to me now as Joey is a senior-senior, with many old age problems. I feel grateful to know she is guiding us through this end-of-life time, which is so emotionally difficult for a Mommy.
Fist time here. Wait time was a bit long but nothing crazy for a first time appointment. They were very helpful and well informed. Looking forward to my second appointment here.
Your feedback is highly appreciated, Bachir. Thank you so much for the review!

Thank you so much for the 5 stars, Wendy! We truly appreciate your support and thank you for trusting us with Goldie’s care. Our team is grateful for your kindness and support of Washington Ave Animal Hospital!
I was in and out.  They were very kind and extremely helpful.
So helpful and went above and beyond when I had a concern with my cat at 630 pm on a Friday. Always so friendly and helpful !
Dr Adams is wonderful! Great staff as well. I highly recommend Washington Ave Vet ❤️😺 …
Our visit was fantastic everything was explained clearly to us and our visit very affordable. Dr cantor made our lucy so comfortable. We love our vet
Recommended! Works well for my dog and cat. My dog likes going there. And wait times are reasonable. The vibe is peaceful and respectful.
Fast service,friendly staff.

I took my dog to WAAP for an Annual Examination. The doctors and staff were excellent despite the fact that my dog is difficult and uncooperative with vet visits. They even called to follow up the next day to see how she was doing. What service!
All I can say is OMG
Very compassionate and caring and took great care of our very senior dog. They also called the next day to check and make sure he was doing better.

I brought my dog here because she was pretty much dying (although I didn’t know it until the day after I brought her here and she was lethargic, bleeding from her rectum).  A simple glucose test would have told these people “hey, Dr. McFly, her glucose is so high she’s dying,” but no.  Rather, they took a sheet and twisted it to make it more like a “log shape”, put it under her hind legs, lifted it and observed her trying to walk. Wouldn’t this be the reaction for any dog?  With that one and only “diagnostic test,” they told me she IVDD, an expensive and 9 times out of 10, fatal condition because of the huge expense to treat (Intervertebral disc disease is a condition where the cushioning discs between the vertebrae of the spinal column either bulge or burst into the spinal cord space).  I was told most times people put their dogs down that have this condition. Remember, I was told this after they put a sheet under her hind legs and no other testing.  I was prescribed two medications she didn’t need and the next morning she was lethargic, barely breathing and bleeding from her rectum.  What great care for the low price of $300. They would only let one of us in to tell us our dog was basically dying. Which I get it Covid, but, no suggestions or offerings of including both people present at the appointment?  Such as putting the other person on the phone?  I thought I was going in to hear a treatment plan and get prescriptions. So my husband wanted to ask the vet a few questions and we were flat out told no, she won’t repeat what she already said.  That the vet would have a nurse come “talk to us” who, couldn’t answer his questions. All the nurse did was give basic discharge instructions and couldn’t answer anything.  Vet came out to get her next patient completely stone faced, turned and left with her next paycheck.  I felt like all of them were the most uncaring, unprofessional and inept “veterinarians” I ever had the displeasure of meeting.  They also had this passive aggressive attitude about them where I felt like my dog’s pain and my sadness was a joke.  I asked how much a particular procedure would cost for this IVDD.  With a smile and nonchalant attitude, like I asked for the price on a bottle of ketchup, the girl says “like $10,000”. “Well, have a great day 😃”.  I’m not exaggerating that either. And the veterinarian herself wasn’t much better.  I was seriously dumbfounded when everything was said and done at the sheer lack of any kind of empathy.  The kicker?  My dog was diabetic and going into shock and with no treatment would subsequently die.  Do they not do vital signs at this office?  Or a simple 1850’s style sheet under the hind legs does the trick for these people?  My dog does not have IVDD by the way and after I took her to a serious, knowledgeable veterinarian I was given insulin for her.  I wouldn’t go to this office for end of life care let alone anything else.
** Response to "we did not see a client with your name yesterday."   Nice try, but yes, you did.
Had a checkup for my cat and appointment went great, staff was very nice and personable. Would definitely recommend!

This place was amazing to my cat Oreo they told me step by step of everything that was going on with my cat I thought that was so great.
I would recommend everyone I know to bring their animals to your place, I already told a couple people about you already. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
always taking good care of my old pup! nice staff.
The staff is very kind and extremely patient with my nervous dog. I highly recommend this Veterinary clinic.

Excellent visit with Dr.Robinson and Carrie! Both listened to my concerns for my dog and provided complete answers to my questions and excellent guidance. They were both true partners in advocacy for my dog’s health.
Lovely staff and comprehensive service. My cat was loved and treated so well.

My first visit with my cat could not have gone better. We got an appt within 2 days, had zero wait time in the lobby, and all employees were very welcoming and kind. Dr Adams provided a thorough and gentle examination and answered all questions. We will definitely be back!
We were on vacation when our dog got hurt.  The clinic got us in next day. The staff was outstanding. Treated our dog with care and compassion. The staff is outstanding

Took our two cats for their annual physical exam and vaccinations. Dr. Adams and the team were absolutely amazing! It is so obvious that they all deeply love and care about the animals and see this much more than some work that needs to be done. We have one extrovert, active, and energetic cat and one introvert, nervous, and shy cat, they treated them with great care and made both of them comfortable. One of our cats had constant digestion issue that we tried to address and treat with other vets but never succeeded. With Dr. Adams’ suggestion, it actually improved so much!!!! This is a great place with great people, me and my cats will keep coming back!
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Courtney! We are delighted that you had a great experience with Washington Ave Animal Hospital .
Amazing doctors and amazing staff and they are really taking care of my French bulldog Bella.

Thank you  for your feedback!
We truly appreciate you trusting us with Jigga’s care and are so glad you had a positive experience with Dr. Ellen Manneschmidt and our team.

We’re always here for you and Jigga whenever you need us! 🐾
Tech Miriam and Dr. Cantor were wonderful 🩷 …
Thank you for the review! We appreciate you trusting us with Thor’s care. We hope he is starting to feel better and look forward to continuing to work towards getting him back to feeling his best.
Had a great first visit
Slightly pricey, but well worth it! they paid great attention to my cat. Fantastic bedside manner, very kind and gentle, and shes been doing much better.
We had a very great experience at our 4 year old dog's annual check up. Dr. Cantor was fantastic and extremely patient with Finn.

Dr Melissa Robinson, who was the most recent provider at my 5 year old dog, Zorro’s appointment, as well all the other vets and supporting techs we have seen have all been super kind, super talented in handling Zorro and have gone out of their way at times to be helpful.  I highly recommend this clinic!
Really helpful and caring 💜 they made Molly feel very comfortable. Friendly staff really clean place. Highly recommend. Will go again …
My cat who is about to be 19 was treated  with such great kindness and respect that she sailed through her exam.we had a great experience with Dr Jarod and his lovely nurse.I was in awe.
The staff here is so great! They are thoughtful, patient and kind. I have a sensitive / nervous dog and they do a great job making him feel calm and going slow.

I brought my cat in very concerned about her constantly being in the litter box. They ordered a urinary analysis which was $220 and couldn’t get the sample from her Wednesday morning. They asked me to bring her back in Friday morning and when I brought her in she was going to also have her rabies vaccine up to date. They told me that would be 68$. So I prepared to have the $68 on Friday for her follow up visit since they couldn’t get the urine sample from her on Wednesday. When I picked her up Friday afternoon, they told me my total was $108 because they had to do another exam on her before giving her her rabies shot? She was just seen 2 days prior. They should’ve told me that I would have to pay another $40 for another exam where they just check her belly and teeth. I felt ripped off and I probably won’t come back due to the lack of communication. It was already hard enough for me to get the $400 (first exam, urinary analysis, gabapentin script & rabies vaccine) together.
Took my cat here, very affordable, very clean, polite staff and gave options for different treatments for different price ranges.

We absolutely love us some doctor Cantor, Je is so amazing with our fur babies. He's kind and caring and will always give you real facts. He great with our animals and will take the time to explain and talk through the appointment. There was also an awesome tech that we worked with during our last visit don't remember her name.  We love her too! Our appt was Friday 1/6.  After a terrible experience we had last year we wasn't  gonna come back to the hospital, but when we learned of Dr Cantors return, that all changed.  The receptionist are also good too, especially Tyler and Shelia. We thank you all for everything!
Great customer service! So kind to my cat Leo .dr.Adam’s is awesome and the nurse was as well.

I’ve been taking my dog here for 4+ years. We’re always seen promptly at our appointment time and everyone is so kind! Our most recent visit was a regular annual with Vet tech Cindy and Dr Ashley Adams and they were both so great with our nervous guy. Everything was explained thoroughly and they followed up with a weight management plan after I asked about suggested diet, which I really appreciate!
Your feedback is highly appreciated, Dallas. Thank you so much for the review!

The staff and providers were very friendly and accommodating. They were able to get me in within a day to schedule a checkup for my newly adopted cat. They had a deal for first time appointments that was great, but even the standard price was very affordable.

My dog was having pain in his legs I took him to hospital they diagnosed him and cared for him appropriately and just 3 days later he is doing well. All who I interacted with the hospital were kind and professional. I will definitely be bringing my dog back to them for all his health care needs.

Wow, what a wonderful experience with Washington Vet!

My boy had a hot spot on his paw, and I reached out for urgent care. They called me immediately that morning and were able to squeeze us in so I could bypass the urgent care fee - huge win already.

From the moment we arrived, we were welcomed so warmly by the front desk team. They even had my previous pet on record and offered sincere condolences for his passing, which truly meant a lot.

My pup is not a fan of the vet, but the vet tech who checked us in was an absolute angel - cheese, peanut butter, patience, and kindness. My 100-lb dog started out hiding behind me on the bench, and within two minutes he was licking her face and wagging his tail.

Dr. Jared came in calm, warm, and incredibly respectful. He eased into the exam, moved slowly, and was clearly focused on making sure my dog felt safe and not frightened. You could tell how much he genuinely cares.

Clean facility, minimal wait time, and an exceptionally kind and compassionate team - from start to finish.

So grateful to have found our new vet. Thank you, Washington Vet team - we’re excited to have you caring for Steve 🐾💙
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful you chose our team for your pet’s care.
Accommodated Theo and I when we were in a difficult situation living in a hotel when my wife was in a nearby hospital.  Very friendly and great service.  Thank you!

Review for Washington Avenue Animal Hospital

Rating: 10/10 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I cannot say enough good things about the team at Washington Animal Hospital!  My husband and I brought our dog Cooper in last Wednesday and the experience was simply unbelievable from start to finish.

This was our first time visiting the clinic, and we were already a bit stressed because Cooper needed quite a bit of work done. To make things more complicated, I scheduled our appointment online, but when we arrived, they realized I was actually confirmed for the following week. Even though the clinic was busy, they did not turn us away. This hospital took the time to fit us in and service us anyway, which was such a relief!

The way Dr. Grace Snyder and the entire team at Washington Ave Hospital treated Cooper was truly wonderful. You can tell when staff genuinely cares about the animals they see. To top it all off, they even called me the next day just to check in and see how Cooper was doing after his treatments. That kind of follow-up is so rare and meant the world to us.

If you are looking for a vet that is professional, compassionate, and goes above and beyond, look no further. 10 out of 10!

We’re so happy to hear that Tuxedo Mask had a great visit with Dr. M and our team. Providing a calm, caring experience and clear communication is always our goal, and it means a lot to know that came through during your visit. Thank you for entrusting us with Tuxedo Mask’s care—we truly appreciate your kind words and trust! 🐾💙 …

I've had multiple issues with incorrect prescription information for our cat. Once I got only 7 pills although it said give every 12 hours for 7 days, which should have been 14 total. I called in and they said the instructions were a mistake at that it should only be every 24 hours. Luckily I caught this before potentially overmedicating my cat. The second time they gave me 10 pills for a course of treatment that was again every 12 hours for 10 days. This time it was a mistake, and I had to go back to their office to pick up another 10 pills.

Two weeks ago I reached out for an Rx refill for our cat's asthma medication. I've done this before, and they email the Rx to me. They told me via chat they'd get back to me in 24 to 48 hours. After a week I checked in again, and was told it was still being worked on and they'd get back to me. After another week,  I checked in again and finally got an answer, which was No. I had to bring him in first because his annual appointment was coming
up. Why did that take 2 weeks? And now I need his meds ASAP.

I will be taking our cat to a new vet ASAP, one that correctly takes care of his prescription needs.
Amazing team! Friendly, thorough and overall loving environment for the animals. My dog had a great time even while not felling well.
they were so sweet to my pup during her annual visit here! she had to get a bunch of shots and they called to check up on her the next day. very professional, nice people :)

My two cats are regular clients but one Saturday I had a concern about one of them and called the animal hospital. They advised bringing her in and scheduled an appointment that morning. The doctor and her assistant took their time with the cat and answered all of my questions. They were wonderful with the cat and me! The cat got the needed care and a couple days after treatment was fully recovering.  I will continue to bring my cats to this animal hospital for the excellent care provided.
The clinic kept trying to charge hidden fees we did not discuss. I ended up paying but am not happy with it.
I loved that they handled my senior kitty with care, and explained everything to us. I was recommended by my mother and grateful that she shared them with me.

We recently switched one of our cats to Washington Ave and I really couldn't be more impressed. The staff has been so polite and helpful, the hours are really convenient, and Dr. Cantor has been amazing. I've never had a veterinary team make me feel like they cared about my pet this much.

Honestly I used to like it here a lot more. I now find they often don’t call back or pay attention. They keep overlooking my dogs issue and my fiance calls and they never ever call him back. It’s carried on to the point that we may find a new vet. She’s sick and they’re not helping which is a bummer.
I had a great experience at Washington pet Hospital. They took me in right away. They solved my cats mystery cat bite. Very Friendly staff. A very clean and efficient workplace.

My dog Sophie was attacked by another dog with a pretty nasty head wound and other wounds around the area and when I walked in greeted by the friendly warm front desk staff they told me they have to check for availability since I was an emergency walk and and the nurse and doctor took my dog even when fully booked to make sure she received the emergency medical care. My dog is super anxious and not trusting but she loved their staffed and went with the no problem, they were so sweet and patient with me and my dog. They were so understanding and communication was amazing between them and I about my dogs care as well as pricing. I can’t thank this place enough and their outstanding staff. My dog is healing and recovering beautifully and even licked the one nurses face the whole time as a thank you. Here’s Sophie after the best care from this facility.
